name: Seeed XIAO ESP32C6
radio: the SoC's own radios: wifi24, ble, ieee802154

flash.bootloader_instructions: Hold BOOT while plugging in USB-C; release after a second. The chip's USB-JTAG-serial port appears.
flash.note: Offset 0x0 is the ESP32-C6 convention. Serial over native USB confirmed on the bench (the factory sketch prints 'Hello from Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6').

usb.when: ESP32-C6 USB-JTAG-serial (download mode and, with CDC on boot, the running firmware)

led.note: yellow LED on GPIO15 (a single digital LED: on/off, no colours)

battery.divider_note: Powered from USB or a 5 V pack. The pack must not have a low-current cut-off, or the board never wakes from deep sleep.

notes: Adds a second 802.15.4 radio to the bench: a partner for the C5 Zigbee coordinator.
Power: a fox sleeps between transmissions; a USB power bank with a low-current auto-off cuts power during the sleep and the fox never wakes. Use a pack without auto-off.
Serial: native USB — the console port disappears while the chip sleeps and returns when it wakes. 'serial port dropped' each cycle is expected.

circuitpython.note: board.LED is the yellow user LED (GPIO15, active low). Battery: the XIAO C6 has a charger but no divider on an ADC pin by default.
